# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are currently provided for the latest public release of **gl1tchb1rd forensic sitesaver**.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** publish security-sensitive details, exploit code, credentials, tokens, cookies, HAR files, screenshots, case data or other forensic material in a public GitHub issue.

If you find a vulnerability, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature for this repository when available. If private reporting is unavailable, open a public issue containing only a short request for a private contact channel and no exploit details.

## Scope

Useful reports include vulnerabilities in the application itself, unsafe handling of locally generated evidence, unintended network communication, bypasses of the passive-navigation safeguards, dependency issues that materially affect the application, or weaknesses in the offline website-safety model.

Third-party services and websites are outside this project's control and should be reported to their respective operators where appropriate.
